items.statement: In studies that adjust for illness severity, higher relational continuity with a family physician is associated with fewer unplanned admissions in adults aged 65 and over.
items.rationale: The central question for the network; the retrieved population study supports it.
items.risks: Residual confounding remains even in adjusted studies.

items.statement: Interventions that raise continuity reduce admissions less than associational estimates suggest.
items.rationale: The only reorganisation study points this way.
